title: APPROVE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND WALKER BROTHERS MACHINERY MOVING, INC. FOR TRANSPORTATION SERVICES
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND WALKER BROTHERS MACHINERY MOVING, INC. FOR TRANSPORTATION SERVICES
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests approval of an Agreement between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and Walker Brothers Machinery Moving, Inc. (Walker) for transportation services specializing in the transport of large equipment, to transport three Port of Los Angeles Waterfront Red Cars (Red Cars) to three museum locations. The Red Cars are a mix of one original and two authentic replicas of the famous 1908 Electric “Red Car” built in 2003 that served Los Angeles until 1961. The relocation of the original Red Car and two replicas from their current location at the corner of 22nd Street and Miner Street to regional rail museums are necessary to allow for construction of the 22nd Street Parking Lot Improvement Project. The proposed Agreement is associated with the Harbor Department's Strategic Plan Objective 4: Strong Relationships with Stakeholders, Initiative 1, which delivers key LA Waterfront development projects on time and on budget; attracts visitors to the LA Waterfront; and identifies other public investment opportunities. Waterfront & Commercial Real Estate staff have negotiated with three entities who have agreed to accept the Red Cars under Memorandum of Understandings, which are being presented to the Board of Harbor Commissioners (Board) for approval at a separate meeting. Approval of the proposed Agreement will allow Walker to provide transportation services, which includes storage, labor, equipment, materials, permits, planning, insurance, supervision, communications, and incidentals necessary to safely transport the Red Cars. The proposed Agreement is for a term of 18 months and a not to exceed amount of $592,218. The Harbor Department will be financially responsible for payment of costs incurred under the proposed Agreement.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with the Los Angele City Charter Section 1022, it is more feasible for an outside contractor to perform this work than City employees; 3) find that in accordance with Los Angeles City Charter Section 371(e)(10) and Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 10.15(a)(10), due to an unsuccessful Request for Proposal process, the Harbor Department can enter into an Agreement with Walker Brothers Machinery Moving, Inc. due to specialized transportation services they provide; 4) approve the Agreement with Walker Brothers Machinery Moving, Inc.; 5) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Agreement; and 6) adopt Resolution No. ____________.
summary: Approval of agreement with Walker Brothers Machinery Moving, Inc. to transport Port of Los Angeles Waterfront Red Cars to three museum locations.
